verdict.rationale: A probe confirms an llms.txt (HTTP 200) on Cloudflare's developer documentation site, which hosts the Registrar docs, and an agent-setup page exists for pointing agents at Cloudflare. The evidence does not show Registrar-specific llms.txt content, and the probe for a markdown version of the Registrar docs page returned 404, so coverage for this product's own docs is incomplete. Missing for 10: confirmation that llms.txt indexes the Registrar docs, a working agent-oriented or markdown rendering of the Registrar docs (the /registrar/.md probe returned 404), and hands-on or independent corroboration of agents using these docs for Registrar tasks.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
